## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Market confirmation is mixed — weak overall sector breadth and dispersed top performers across Healthcare, Technology and Industrials (Leadership: Mixed, 3 sectors in Top 5) alongside multiple large-cap trend divergences, supporting a neutral read.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%), AMGN RECOVERY (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%), NVS RECOVERY (1W: +4.18% | 1M: -5.02%). Materials showing pocket strength: ECL RECOVERY (1W: +3.80% | 1M: -1.73%). Industrials strength is selective: EMR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.06% | 1M: +1.07%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag: MS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -4.90%). Technology weak on breadth despite leaders: ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%). Communication and Real Estate also under pressure.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMGN RECOVERY (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%), EMR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.06% | 1M: +1.07%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.69% | 1M: -24.89%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -9.27%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -12.15%). Weakness concentrated in select Tech and cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%), PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%), DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%). Major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M including AAPL, GOOGL, META), so treat moves as tactical—watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed — select names ABOVE TREND (PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%)) while large-cap software and cloud names are BELOW TREND (ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%)) and others in CORRECTION (GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +0.68%), META CORRECTION (1W: -3.46% | 1M: +25.40%)). Sector 1W: -1.82% overall.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft — broad weakness with majors BELOW TREND (MS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -9.02%)); few pockets of stability absent. Sector 1W: -3.03% overall.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively constructive and defensive: DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +2.33%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +0.74%). Sector 1W: +1.69% overall.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Healthcare and industrial stocks showing ABOVE TREND (DHR, EMR, AMAT) and monitor quality Tech swing names (PANW, LRCX) for follow-through; reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap tech/software names and pressured Financials. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%). BEARISH: ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%) — watch for extension of recent weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +1.69%) — watch names holding ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Financials and Technology — both showing negative 1W performance and leadership dispersion; breadth will determine regime tilt.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AAPL for support at the recent monthly pivot (CORRECTION hold) and NVDA for short-term support near the weekly pullback (ABOVE TREND hold); ORCL and INTU downside continuation below recent weekly lows would increase sector risk; DHR breakout above recent swing highs would confirm continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
No sentiment data available today to flag specific catalysts; monitor Healthcare movers (DHR, AMGN) for any upcoming company-level news.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
No sentiment data available today; recent price action flags ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) and INTU (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%) as priority items to watch for negative developments.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%), AMGN RECOVERY (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (AAPL CORRECTION; GOOGL CORRECTION; broad Financials weakness) with limited sentiment confirmation — monitor for trend breaks.
